subject: Request for Trash Receptacle Installation - Waterfront Dr & Skimboard Park Access
comment:
To whom it may concern,

I am writing to request the installation of a public trash can at a high-traffic point on Waterfront Dr. Specifically, the best location would be at the end of the railing closest to 207 S Waterfront Dr, directly in front of the steps that lead down to the Virgin River trail and the skimboard park. Because this spot serves as a primary entrance for the skimboard park and the trail system, it sees significant foot traffic. Currently, there is a recurring litter problem in this exact area because visitors have no convenient place to dispose of trash before or after using the stairs.

A permanent bin here would greatly help keep our riverfront and trail system clean. Thank you for your time and for all you do to maintain our city.

I'm happy to provide pictures of which location I believe will be best or of the current litter problem that is continually getting worse if requested.

Best regards,
Sianead Staheli
